newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures fall further on selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures fall further on selling.

text.p: Castorseeed September delivery fell further by three rupees to 1,139 rupees per quintal (100 kg) on Tuesday on unabated speculative selling, dealers said.
Castorseed September delivery lost 15 rupees per quintal on Monday.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell further by two rupees to 358 rupees per 10 kg as arrivals continued in the western state of Gujarat, the country's peanut bowl.
In Rajkot, groundnut oil lost 8.0/9.0 rupees to 359 rupees per 10 kg.
